name: job_scrape
description: Scrape Software Engineering jobs from Google Jobs (remote, posted in the last 1 day). If none are found, print NO_JOBS; otherwise save all jobs to jobs_<currentdate>.txt.

settings.action: Fetch https://example.com/ and print the response to confirm network access before scraping.

Search Google Jobs for 'Software Engineering' positions filtered to remote roles posted in the last 1 day. Collect every matching job listing with its title, company, location, and link. Record the full list of listings as the variable scraped_jobs and record the number of listings found as the variable job_count.
set raw web content into raw_web variable.

Save every listing in the scraped_jobs variable into a file named jobs_<currentdate>.txt, where <currentdate> is today's date. Write one job per entry with its title, company, location, and link, and confirm the file was written.
Print the text NO_JOBS to indicate that no matching Software Engineering remote jobs posted in the last 1 day were found.

variables.description: Full list of scraped job listings as a JSON array, each entry an object with title, company, location, link. Set by the scrape step and read by the save step.
